Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 crore revenue milestone supported by its strategic transition into a value-added coated steel manufacturer. The company commenced commercial production at its new Alu-Zinc coating line (1,10,200 TPA capacity) in June 2025, augmented its existing colour-coated line capacity, and progressed on a new colour-coated line (CCL II) expected to be completed in FY 2026-27. Management has guided for consolidated revenues of INR 1,500 crore in FY 2026-27 and approximately INR 3,000 crore in FY 2028-29 following a planned INR 100 crore investment in a 6-Hi Reversible Cold-Rolling mill scheduled for December 2027. Manaksia Steels reported financial results for FY 2024-25, including a revenue of H584.18 Crore and an EBITDA of H25.69 Crore, alongside ongoing capacity expansions in Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel lines funded entirely through internal accruals. Management highlighted strong rural and semi-urban demand drivers for value-added steel products, improved sales tonnage by 15%, and executed strategic investments to scale aggregate production capacity to 400,000 TPA.

guidance.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
demand_outlook.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore comprises the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: Realisation and EBITDA margins were impacted during the year under review due to a decrease in overall sales realisation and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review, which was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review. This was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.

management_commitments.claim: The second expansion programme comprising the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.
